Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Compliance & Safety Department Assistant role at NHV in Ostend. With a background in digital marketing and web management, I have developed strong administrative, organisational and documentation skills that align well with the responsibilities of this position.

In my current roles, I manage content and documentation across various platforms, ensuring accuracy and timely follow-up. I have experience with SharePoint-based digital workplace sites, which has given me a solid understanding of document management systems. I am fluent in English and comfortable working with detailed information, and I am eager to learn about aviation compliance and safety management.

I am reliable, proactive and able to communicate assertively with colleagues and stakeholders. I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to NHV's Compliance and Safety Department and to grow within the role.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing this further.

Kind regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Compliance & Safety Department Assistant position at Noordzee Helikopters Vlaanderen, as advertised. With a strong foundation in digital marketing and web management, I have honed my administrative and organisational skills in fast-paced environments, and I am eager to bring my attention to detail and proactive approach to your Compliance and Safety Department.

In my recent roles, I have been responsible for managing content and documentation across multiple platforms, ensuring that information remains accurate and up to date. For instance, at Knowledge Experts (KXP), I supported the team in building SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for major clients, which required meticulous organisation and follow-up. This experience has given me a solid understanding of document management systems and the importance of maintaining complete and accurate records. Additionally, my freelance work has involved creating and maintaining websites, where I have had to adhere to strict deadlines and ensure all content is current and error-free.

I possess excellent organisational and planning skills, and I am comfortable working with detailed and confidential information. My communication style is professional and assertive, enabling me to follow up on actions and deadlines in a firm but respectful manner. I am fluent in English and have a good command of Dutch, which I am continuously improving. While I do not have a background in aviation, I am a quick learner and am excited about the opportunity to receive on-the-job training in aviation compliance and safety management.

I am particularly drawn to NHV's commitment to quality and safety, and I would relish the chance to contribute to a team that values responsibility, autonomy and visible impact. I am confident that my administrative skills, combined with my flexibility and hands-on approach, make me a strong candidate for this role.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
